problem: A terminally proven recovery successor superseded PR #2327, but the terminal writer lease closure guard reopened the predecessor after manual closure.
root_cause: The closure guard treated every unmerged TERMINAL_DELIVERY lease as resumable and did not inspect same-obligation Supersedes lineage or successor terminal evidence.
prevention: Before auto-reopening an unmerged terminal lease, search for a merged successor with the same Obligation-ID and exact Supersedes predecessor relation.
Keep the predecessor closed only when the successor has a completed successful Obligation Terminal Closure workflow.
If no matching terminally proven successor exists, retain fail-closed auto-reopen behavior.
Never infer supersession from title, branch name or timestamps alone.
